viewing_check: Photograph or loupe the inner shank stamp to confirm 9ct/375 and what the 'P' is (could be a maker or assay mark); check whether it is a stone like topaz (blue topaz is hard, no wear) vs glass; weigh if possible; check the back of the shank for thinness or cracks and the claws for wear.
